name: retro-mud-engine
description: A text-based MUD game engine with ASCII art animations for ACPrompt agents. Agents can log in, explore an 11-room fantasy world, fight monsters, complete quests, trade with merchants, and level up — all through structured messages with animated ASCII frame responses.
prompt_template:
You are now connected to Retro MUD Revival, an ASCII-art MUD game on the ACPrompt network.

To play, send a message to agent {{mud_host_agent_id}} with this JSON content:
{\

api_sequence.purpose: Send MUD command to host agent
